summary: Working in philosophy and Buddhist studies, Miri Albahari earned an MA from the University of Otago and a PhD in 2005 from the University of Calgary under John A. Baker. Affiliations include the University of New South Wales and the University of Western Australia.

Miriam Levering was a scholar in Buddhist studies, religious studies, and sinology who completed her PhD at Harvard University in 1978. She later served as Professor of Religious Studies at the University of Tennessee, attested between 2007 and 2010.

Mirjan Damaška studied law at the University of Zagreb, the Hague Academy of International Law, the Faculté Internationale de Droit Comparé, and the University of Ljubljana (PhD 1960). His career included professorships at the University of Pennsylvania and Yale University.
Mitchell G. Weiss is an Indologist who studied under Ludo Rocher. He has held a post as Professor at the University of Basel.

Working in Indology and linguistics, Mithilesh Chaturvedi has been affiliated with the Department of Sanskrit at the University of Delhi, attested as faculty in 2009 and as Professor emeritus in 2026.

Mitsuji Fukunaga, a specialist in sinology and philosophy, studied at Hiroshima Higher Normal School and Kyoto University. He taught at Kyoto University (1961–1982), the University of Tokyo (1974–1979), Kansai University (1982–1986), and the University of Kitakyushu (1986–1989).
Mitsukuni Yoshida was a scholar of history, archaeology, and Japanology who studied at Kyoto University from around 1942 to 1945 and later held a post at Kyoto University of the Arts.
Mitsunobu Nakasone is a Buddhist studies scholar attested as a part-time lecturer at Bukkyo University in 2005 and affiliated with Kyoto Bunkyo Junior College in 2020.
Mitsutoshi Moriguchi is an Indologist and Buddhist studies scholar who completed doctoral coursework at Taisho University, where he later served as a lecturer (attested 1989–1995).
Working in Indology and Buddhist studies, Mitsuyo Demoto studied at Kyoto University and held an affiliation at the University of Marburg attested in 2024.

Mitsuyoshi Saegusa studied at the University of Tokyo, the University of Munich (PhD ~1962), and Kokugakuin University (doctorate 1971). A scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy, he was a professor at the University of Tsukuba (1975–1987) and Nihon University.
Mitsuyuki Ishida was a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Ryukoku University. He later served as a professor at Ryukoku University and at Shitennoji University, both attested in 1976.
Miyako Notake is a scholar of Indology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy who served as a part-time lecturer at Waseda University, attested in 2015 and 2026.

Mizuho Okita works in religious studies and Indology, having studied at Tokai University, Gakushuin University, under Katsuhiko Kamimura, and with doctoral supervisor Atsuhiko Yoshida. Okita was attested as a part-time lecturer at Meisei University in 2008.
Mizumaro Ishida was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Japanology who held a professorship at Tokai University, attested in 1976 and 1987.
Mohammad Ashraf Dar is a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology who earned an MPhil from Vikram University and was attested there as a research scholar in 2014.
Mohammad Habib was a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology. He studied at the University of Allahabad (~1912–1916), Aligarh Muslim University, and New College (~1916–1920).

Mohan G. Dhadphale is a scholar of Indology and Buddhist studies who served as a professor at Tilak Maharashtra Vidyapeeth (attested 2000) and as editor of Annals at the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute (attested 2003).

Mokurai Shimaji, a figure in Buddhist and religious studies, studied under Chō Sanshū. He served as managing director at Nishi Hongan-ji (1870), founded Chiyoda Jogakuen (1888), and was the 25th head priest of Gankyo-ji (1892–1905).

Mona Schrempf works in Tibetology and religious studies. She earned a doctorate in anthropology from the Free University of Berlin (2001) and held posts at the Humboldt University of Berlin and Heidelberg University (attested 2006).
